name: caps-lock
title: Caps Lock
description: Toggle Caps Lock even when your Caps Lock key is remapped to Hyper, Escape, Control, or another key.
author: itsdanielsultan

commands.name: toggle-caps-lock
commands.title: Toggle Caps Lock
commands.description: Turn Caps Lock on or off without pressing the physical Caps Lock key.

commands.name: caps-lock-on
commands.title: Turn Caps Lock On
commands.description: Turn Caps Lock on (does nothing if it is already on).

commands.name: caps-lock-off
commands.title: Turn Caps Lock Off
commands.description: Turn Caps Lock off (does nothing if it is already off).

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Caps Lock Indicator
commands.description: Show whether Caps Lock is on in the menu bar, with a one-click toggle.

preferences.name: hideWhenOff
preferences.title: Visibility
preferences.label: Only show while Caps Lock is on
preferences.description: Hide the menu bar icon whenever Caps Lock is off.
